purpose: the cost preflight of case 02b's version: 200, a source-bound, recorded-mode, run-scope estimate of the plain analysis, read-only. Case 03 confirms exactly this estimate. EDITED AFTER CAPTURE, ONE WAY (D-322): the six optional properties the version does not set (connection_revision_id, preset_revision_id, executor_group_id, executor_group_revision_id, routing_rule_revision_id, pin_id) are ABSENT here, as the contract declares them (optional, not nullable); the served body carries them as null, a deviation the comparison projects back in memory (_estimate_nulls_expected) so it is named, counted and removable instead of frozen in this file
pre_authorization: Captured after the T-6 seam landed. Every request here presents the configured bearer credential and is answered. No record here exercises a caller's rights, so none pins 401 or 403.

request.body_note: RunCostEstimateRequest, version_uid only; the operation declares no Idempotency-Key

tokens.{{content_length}}: a function of the body, which is compared byte for byte; the comparison asserts Content-Length == str(len(body)) separately
tokens.{{correlation_id}}: assigned by the edge because the request carried none; checked against the pinned CorrelationId shape before being tokenised
tokens.{{estimate_digest}}: a verification value the cost preflight computes over the version's source facts, the route and the pinned rates, read from the declared field 'estimate_digest' and checked against the contract's Sha256 pattern ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ before being tokenised; cases 03 to 05 send it back as the consent, and the start recomputes it and refuses a different one with run_cost_estimate_stale
tokens.{{session_tag}}: this capture run's tag, carried by every idempotency key
